<script>
/* Fix Leaking Showers - GA4 lead + phone tracking for the Base44 site.
   Replaces the old WPForms watcher. Fires the existing "Thank_You" and
   "Phone_Calls" events, so the GA4 key event setup does not need to change. */
(function () {
  if (window.__flsTracking) return;
  window.__flsTracking = true;

  function send(name, params) {
    params = params || {};
    params.transport_type = 'beacon';
    if (typeof window.gtag === 'function') {
      window.gtag('event', name, params);
    } else {
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push(['event', name, params]);
    }
  }

  /* 1. Form enquiries: watch the Nifty lead request and fire once it succeeds.
        Works whether the site shows the inline thank you message or redirects
        to /thank-you/, and does not fire when a submission fails. */
  var LEAD = '/admin/api/lead';
  var origFetch = window.fetch;
  if (origFetch) {
    window.fetch = function (input, init) {
      var url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : (input && input.url) || '';
      var method = ((init && init.method) || (input && input.method) || 'GET').toUpperCase();
      var p = origFetch.apply(this, arguments);
      if (method === 'POST' && url.indexOf(LEAD) !== -1) {
        var page = window.location.pathname;
        p.then(function (res) {
          var ok = function (data) {
            if (data && data.ok === false) return;
            send('Thank_You', { event_category: 'form', event_label: page });
          };
          try {
            res.clone().json().then(ok, function () { if (res.ok) ok({ ok: true }); });
          } catch (e) { if (res.ok) ok({ ok: true }); }
        }, function () {});
      }
      return p;
    };
  }

  /* 2. Phone clicks: one listener for every tel: link, including ones in the
        footer bar and slide-out form. */
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var a = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href^="tel:" i]') : null;
    if (!a) return;
    send('Phone_Calls', { event_category: 'number', event_label: a.getAttribute('href') });
  }, true);
})();
</script>
